purpose: Feedback-directed TRAINING curriculum; not an independent evaluation corpus.
controlled_expansions_disclosed: 60 protected-literal active corrections use deliberately repeated negative-context structures across individually authored subjects: 20 both old/new quoted, 20 old quoted/new plain, 20 mixed situations.
40 local-scope cases deliberately repeat a corrected word/entity later in an unretracted independent instruction or fact.
40 minimal repairs include 10 unfinished-word restarts, 6 interrupted noun-phrase restarts, 16 tense/voice-preserving hesitation removals, 8 discourse/grammatical-repeat examples.
40 unchanged controls cover 10 reported correction phrases, 10 deliberate repeats, 10 punctuation-instruction-as-data examples, 10 exact literal cases.
These are controlled assistant-authored synthetic training expansions, not 180 independent naturally occurring dictations or evidence of 99% generalization.
provenance: Authored from the parent-provided failure-family brief only. No retired validation case text or new blind content was opened for this task; no external corpus text was imported.
integration_instruction: Use only train-180-v1.jsonl as the 180-row training input. Part files are preserved authoring artifacts and must not be concatenated with the complete input.
